text: happens with long patch cycles, not really surprising. the truth is meta is highly determined by player comfort and also attenuated to how habituated your opponent is to a hero/drafting strategy. once someone breaks the seal on a 'dead' hero player comfort and confidence playing it comes back, and opponents aren't habituated to dealing with it. especially in the carry role, it's easier/faster for one player to start performing well on a dead hero coming off of being cold on it than it is for an entire opponent team to get habituated to countering it.
